In the middle of the NFL action during the Philadelphia Eagles vs. Jacksonville Jaguars game in London, global Afrobeat star Ayra Starr is set to perform at halftime. She’s the first Afrobeat artist and Nigerian to headline an NFL halftime show in the league’s history.

After nearly 20 years of game play, the NFL returns to London for the second game of the 2026-27 season . The league has been growing American Football around the world with regular season games played in international cities, such as Rio , Mexico City, Melbourne, Berlin, Dublin and others.

When Does the NFL London Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL London Game happens on Sunday (Oct. 11) with a matchup featuring the Philadelphia Eagles (2-2) taking on the Jacksonville Jaguars (3-1) at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London, England, with a start time of 9:30 a.m. ET/6:30 a.m. PT (2:30 p.m. BST).

What TV Network Features the NFL London Game 2026?

The Eagles-Jaguars game broadcasts on NFL Network, while the NFL game is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL London Game 2026?

NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include English NFL fans, Idris Elba, Kit Harington, Prince William and others.

In addition, Nigerian Afrobeats singer-songwriter and BET Award-winner Ayra Starr performs at halftime . It starts around 11 a.m. ET/8 a.m. PT (3 p.m. BST).
